subtitle: A deep-sea expedition to the ocean floor aboard the EREBUS.

sections.title: How deep will you go?
sections.body: Eight civilians a year. One submersible. The ocean floor.

sections.title: 99% of sunlight is already gone.
sections.body: God rays fade. Bubble columns rise past the viewport.

sections.title: Pressure is 100× the surface.
sections.body: Ghostly jellyfish drift. The floodlights flicker on.

sections.title: No sun has ever reached this water.
sections.body: Life makes its own light. The dark sparks around the hull.

sections.title: Fewer have stood here than have walked on the moon.
